correctness.rationale: Four-case exhaustive classification of equality patterns: visible short cycles; no-cross ordered periods; same-cycle short offsets; and long-cycle signed residue sets of size at most two. Distinct short copies, all intermediate long lengths and one >=2d+1 cycle are forced; canonical cycles meet bound and realize every case, hence are unique at equality. Standalone literal equality-matrix tests d=1..5 and exhaustive smaller partition tests d=1,2 corroborate but do not replace the all-d proof.
